system.description:
You can control fire: put out flames, produce a small flame, make a burning source burn harder, or anything else the Director allows. Once per Doom Quarter, use an Attack Action to hurl a fireball: 3 Fire damage, Long Range (150 ft).

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.95
system.summary: You can control fire: put out flames, produce a small flame, make a burning source burn harder, or anything else the Director allows. Once per Doom Quarter, use an Attack Action to hurl a fireball: 3 Fire damage, Long Range (150 ft).

automation.note: Fire control has no stated use limit or action cost; the Director rules on each use. Rolling this power makes the once-per-Doom-Quarter fireball Strike.
